1  NAFR  HIGH COURT OF CHHATTISGARH, BILASPUR  MCRCA No. 1722 of 2022

Suresh Kashyap S/o Shri Santram Kashyap Aged About 38 Years R/o  Village - Boirpara, P.S. And Tahsil Lalpur, District Mungeli,
 Chhattisgarh.
---- Petitioner  Versus   State of Chhattisgarh, Through: The S.H.O. P.S. - Lalpur, District  Mungeli, Chhattisgarh.
---- Respondent For Applicant : Mr. Dhaneshwar Yadav, Adv.

For Respondent/State : Mr. Rahul Jha, G.A.
 Hon'ble Smt. Justice Rajani Dubey  Order on Board 21/02/2023 1.

This is the second anticipatory bail application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No. 87/2022 registered at Police Station- Lalpur, District- Mungeli (C.G.) for commission of the offence punishable under Sections 420, 34 of IPC.

2. The first anticipatory bail application of the applicant was dismissed by this Court vide order dated 06.09.2022 in MCRCA No. 887/2022.
3.

The prosecution case, in brief, is that in the years 2021-22, Sewa Sahakari Samiti Suretha having registration No. 841 Block Lormi purchased the paddy from agriculturist by registering the Government land as well as the land of a temple in the name of the present applicant and other co-accused persons and obtained the support price as well as a bonus for selling the paddy.

A primary enquiry was conducted and it appears that with the collusion of the concerned patwari,
government land has been registered in the name of the present applicant and other agriculturists and they have sold the paddy as per the said registration for which the amount has been transferred Suresh Kashyap vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160444763/
1 in their account and have committed cheating.

sentences.text: Based on this, offence has been registered against the present applicant.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the present applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He next submits that the applicant has been granted ad-interim bail till the disposal of this bail application.
He next submits that similarly placed co-accused persons namely Mannu Kashyap and Jitendra Kumar Kashyap have already been granted bail by this Court in MCRCA No. 1789/2022 and MCRCA No. 1384/2022.
He also submits that the applicant has already been granted interim protection by the co-ordinate Bench in WPCR No. 836/2022 for a limited period.
Therefore, the present applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.
5. On the other hand, counsel for the State opposes the application for anticipatory bail.

6. After hearing counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of the case, in particular, the facts that similarly placed co-accused persons have already been granted bail and the applicant has already been granted interim protection by the co-ordinate Bench in WPCR No.
836/2022, this Court is of the considered opinion that it is a fit case to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.
